subject: Procurement kickoff: vendor setup, PO path & MAP alignment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dan Jenkins <dan.jenkins@novacorp.com>, Maya Collins <maya.collins@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff: vendor setup, PO path & MAP alignment

Hi Dan / Maya —

Thanks again for agreeing to move forward with Redwood. To keep momentum, I want to schedule an initial procurement kickoff to cover vendor setup, PO routing, and mutual action plan (MAP) alignment so both teams have clear owners and timelines. Proposed outcomes:

- Confirm vendor data + attachments required for our vendor profile (W-9, bank remit, insurance, SOC2 if applicable)
- Agree on PO intake path and estimated lead times for Finance/AR
- Review MAP milestones, owners, and success criteria (e.g., test environment access, first production inference run)
- Identify any contract/terms blockers that would change timeline

Suggested slots (30–45 min):
- Wed Aug 16, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Aug 17, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri Aug 18, 09:30–10:00 PT

Please let me know which works for you or share a preferred time. I’ve attached our vendor onboarding form and an initial MAP we can iterate on. If there’s a procurement contact or a specific PO template we should use, share that and we’ll incorporate.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable); MAP_Draft_v0.1.xlsx

Next steps after kickoff: Ben will own PO intake/coordination with Finance; Monica will own vendor activation in our systems; I’ll lead MAP updates and rollout planning.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Dan Jenkins <dan.jenkins@novacorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Collins <maya.collins@novacorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Aug 2028 08:02:07 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: vendor setup, PO path & MAP alignment

Vivek —

Thanks. Wed 10:00 PT (that’s 13:00 our time) works for us. I’ll include our procurement lead (procurement@novacorp.com) on the calendar invite. A couple quick items we need on our side before kickoff: 

- Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a signed Master Services Agreement before a PO can be issued, or if our PO + standard terms are acceptable?
- We need your W-9 and your SOC 2 attestation (or a plan/timeline if you’re in progress).
- Please indicate whether you accept vendor onboarding via our Coupa/Ariba workflows — we can provide a supplier onboarding link if needed.

Also, attach any example invoice template you prefer (so we route to the right GL). I’ll bring procurement and legal to the call if anything looks non-standard.

Thanks — looking forward to Wed.
Dan
Dan Jenkins
Senior Procurement Manager
Novacorp
dan.jenkins@novacorp.com
+1 (212) 555-0147

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dan Jenkins <dan.jenkins@novacorp.com>, Maya Collins <maya.collins@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Wed, 16 Aug 2028 09:17:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: vendor setup, PO path & MAP alignment

Dan —

Great — I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed Aug 16 10:00 PT. Quick answers ahead of the call so we’re efficient: 

- MSA vs PO: We typically execute an MSA for multi-month/committed Dedicated customers, but for self-serve / single-contract procurements a standard PO referencing our terms is acceptable. If legal still prefers an MSA, we can surface a clean copy and flag any non-standard clauses up front.
- W-9: attached (Redwood_W9.pdf). SOC2: we have a current SOC 2 report; we can share the attestation PDF and an access path through our compliance portal post-LOA. I’ll flag compliance to bring the attestation link to the call if helpful.
- Coupa/Ariba: we support supplier onboarding via both. If you’d like us in your Coupa instance, send the supplier invite link and Ben will complete the enrollment.

Attachments: Redwood_Filled_Onboarding_Form.pdf (completed), Redwood_W9.pdf, MAP_v0.2.xlsx (updated — added owners and target dates).

Summary of proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) Supplier enrollment complete — owner: Ben Carter — target: Aug 23
2) PO received and accepted — owner: Novacorp Procurement (Dan) — target: Aug 25
3) Test account & sample inference run — owner: Monica Patel — target: Aug 30
4) Production enablement / go-live — owners: Monica + Vivek — target: Sep 8

Success criteria to validate on the call: test inference under production-like payload; payment terms agreed; any compliance evidence confirmed.

If those owners/times look off, we’ll adjust on the call. Also adding a link to a short shared checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP_v0.2

Thanks — see you on the call.
Vivek

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: vendor setup, PO path & MAP alignment

Thanks everyone — calendar invite accepted. Quick notes from ops: 

- We received Dan’s supplier onboarding note and attached the completed onboarding form so your team can confirm fields. If Novacorp prefers a Coupa invite, please send the supplier registration URL and Ben will complete within 24 hours.
- Finance prefers invoices sent to ap@novacorp.com with the PO number in the subject; if you have a special remit address, include it on the PO so AR routes correctly.
- I’ll own the sandbox/provisioning once we have the PO; typical provisioning lead time is 3 business days after enrollment.

Looking forward to confirming on the call — I’ll bring a short checklist to walk through during the 15-minute MAP review.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
